summary: Implement v0.9 role architecture with System Architect default, mutation-capable specialists, deterministic role/mutation governance, bounded handoffs, and planner continuity metadata; defer local worker delegation to v1.0.

candidates.rationale: Create the canonical role protocol, policy, profiles, deterministic resolver, handoff validator, and tests.
Integrate role routing into existing selective-context, CLI, profile, and verification surfaces.
Allow non-authoritative planner tasks to carry optional target-role, context-reference, and acceptance-criteria continuity metadata.
Bind mutation commit-readiness to an actor role and fail closed when accepted targets exceed that role mutation envelope.
Open v0.9.0-dev, route role selection during startup, preserve planner continuity guidance, and defer Ornith/local-worker delegation to v1.0.

applied_changes.description: Added role protocol/policy, System/Runtime and scoped authoring profiles, role resolver, handoff validation, and role tests.
Integrated role routing into profile/tool/config routers, CLI, impact policy, and specialist tests.
Extended planner tasks with optional non-authoritative role/context/acceptance continuity metadata.
Added actor-role mutation-envelope validation to mutation governance and commit-readiness tests.
Opened v0.9.0-dev role-governed runtime metadata and updated startup/roadmap contracts.
